recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, comic-style illustration featuring a character with dreadlocks and glasses peeking over a large globe that they are hugging. The globe features heart-shaped landmasses and is encircled by a golden chain. The central text is rendered in a bold, 3D hand-drawn style following the curve of the globe.
coreVisualRelationships: Character arms framing the circular globe
Text following the upper curvature of the globe
Golden chain bisecting the lower half of the globe
High contrast between the orange background and the green/purple globe
coreInvariants: Grainy, stippled texture across all surfaces
Bold black outlines on all elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The globe is the central, dominant element occupying 70% of the frame, with the character's head and arms framing the top and sides.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, circular globe acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the character's eyes, follows the arms down to the chain, and then circles back up through the curved 3D text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The vibrant orange background provides textured negative space that pushes the central subject forward.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Orange background and Purple/Green globe surfaces.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow for the 3D text and golden chain.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout with a consistent mid-tone value range, unified by a dark grain texture.

letterConstructionRules: Extruded 3D depth pointing downwards and to the right
Letters follow a radial arc path
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant custom lettering style paired with a standard metadata block at the bottom.

candidateDirections.reason: To achieve the specific 3D warp and hand-drawn feel

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a grainy, comic-style illustration of a character with dreadlocks and glasses hugging a large globe. The globe should have heart-shaped green landmasses on a purple sea. The background is a textured orange. A golden chain wraps around the globe.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, yellow 3D hand-drawn uppercase text following the curve of the globe's top half. Apply a heavy black outline and a grainy texture to the letters.

verificationChecks: Text follows the curve of the globe
Grainy texture is applied to all elements
Character is peeking from behind the globe

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the character
Specific wording of the central text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the 3D text depth is consistent
Check that the chain appears to wrap around the sphere
Verify the heart shapes are clearly visible in the landmasses
Confirm the grain texture doesn't obscure the main outlines
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Comic Illustration + Grainy Texture + 3D Arc Lettering + Central Circular Subject
